content: Self-ensemble Bootstrapping: Another way to estimate INLINEFORM0 corresponds to bootstrapping. The idea is to estimate the unknown labels as the predictions of the model learned from the previous round of training. Bootstrapping has been explored for domain adaptation in previous works BIBREF18 , BIBREF19 . However, in their methods, domain discrepancy was not explicitly minimized via feature adaptation. Applying bootstrapping or other semi-supervised learning techniques in this case may worsen the results as the classifier can perform quite bad on the target data.
